desc: FINAL STATIC RESULT: OPEN / R3 NO-GO. PAC-aware 25F84 decode found the actual processModeFlags detach branches, software-only USB2/USB3 object removal, HPM inactive/active mask reconstruction, and framework-managed semantic eUSB2/ACIO shutdown. It still found no VBUS-off operation, race-safe inverse for the 0x14 OR mutation plus W1C/cache state, exact mask/detect restoration, restoration of observed pre-SSPS state 0x07, preserving 0x23 inverse/neutral 0x55, or safe cross-layer teardown order. Do not build/run 102-108 without new primary evidence. Evidence: done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm2-detach-static-slice.md. RISK CALIBRATION 2026-07-25: the earlier framing implying an unrecoverable/permanently-damaged port is WITHDRAWN. No persistent-brick mechanism exists in the staged op set (no flash/OTP/patch-bundle writes; runtime register RMW + 4CC only), SN201202x state is volatile and re-initialized by AppleHPM each boot, and the right port holds only the passive stick (M1 cable is on the DFU port). Worst realistic case is odd port state until a power cycle, which is free in a workflow that power-cycles every chainload. The ticket-096 sequence decode remains incomplete, which is a separate completeness question tracked in 096 and not a danger statement. See done/2026-07-25-t6040-r3-risk-calibration.md. FRESH ATTEMPT AUTHORIZED 2026-07-25 (claude): a new-context agent may re-attack this decode with the primary corpus at /private/tmp/t6040-usb-kexts-25F84/ (AppleHPM, AppleSPMI, AppleT6040TypeCPhy, AppleTypeCPhy, usb.AppleSynopsysUSBXHCI) and /private/tmp/kernelcache.release.mac16j, starting from Sol's slice (done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm2-detach-static-slice.md) and not redoing what it proves. Targets: a VBUS-off/source-disable op; a race-safe inverse for the 0x14 OR mutation incl. cached/W1C state; mask/detect restoration; restoration of pre-SSPS state 0x07; inverse or neutral for 0x23/0x24/0x55; and a safe cross-layer teardown order (HPM<->eUSB2<->ATC<->ACIO/DWC3). Deliver FOUND (with quoted evidence, bounds, ordering) or NOT FOUND (with what was searched) per item. arm64e/PAC virtual dispatch: follow the slice's Type10 vmap; bound ipsw queries (macho info --fixups on the full kernelcache pegs cores for a long time). Static only: no rig, no SPMI, do not build or run an R3 artifact.
